learning.title: CaM-Wolf: Causal-Aware Multimodal Agents for Social Deduction Games
learning.summary:
arXiv:2607.26393v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Social deduction games (SDGs) such as Werewolf have become challenging testbeds for AI agents. These games require complex social skills such as reasoning, deception, and collaboration. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have driven significant progress in SDG agents, current approaches are predominantly text-based, overlooking the multimodal nature that is fundamental to human social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce CaM-Wolf, the first SDG agent that integrates multimodal perception and generation. CaM-Wolf processes video inputs from other players, employs a causal-aware Reasoner trained via reinforcement learning to establish logical chains between observable behaviors and hidden roles, and presents itself through an animated avatar. Our experiments and user study show that CaM-Wolf achieves superior agent gameplay performance and enhances the quality of human-AI interaction. This work represents a sign

news.title: Credit Agricole CFO Says Italy is Strategic Market
news.summary: Crédit Agricole Deputy General Manager and CFO Clotilde L'Angevin Original told Bloomberg TV that Italy is a strategic market for the bank, representing 20% of its net income. Asked about a possible merger between Banco BPM, which counts Credit Agricole as its largest investor, and  Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena  she said that Credit Agricole is “key to the setup, thanks to our 29.3% position.” “Nothing can be done without us and nothing can be done against us,” she added. (Source: Bloomberg)
